اقتتلتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَتَلَتَا (iqtatalatā) /iq.ta.ta.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# اُقْتُتِلَتَا (uqtutilatā) /uq.tu.ti.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
